results.summary:
Track A verify-and-synthesize (root A). No source changes — A1-A6 (and A7/#325, which routed the verbs) already shipped the behaviour. This pass checked the pieces fit, walked the scratch-repo protocol end to end, and wrote the docs no child could.

**1. Pieces fit.** `node --test test/store.test.js` — 55/55 pass, both drivers (github + local). `node bin/hkb.js dispatch --dry-run --json` on this repo's own GitHub-backed board returns the same shape as before the seam (reconciled/reclaimed/promoted/guarded/claimed/spawn_failed/held/skipped/tracks/reaped/self_heal/auto_merge/fatal/track_conflicts), no error.

**2. The scratch-repo walk-through**, exact commands, run in a throwaway dir with a bare 'origin' remote (deleted after):
```
git init --bare                          # origin-bare
git init -b main && git config user.*    # repo
git add README.md && git commit -m init
git remote add origin ../origin-bare && git push -u origin main

node bin/hkb.js init --store local --no-hook --repo scratch/repo --no-labels
  -> store: local — created the kb-board branch and .git/hkb/index.db
git add -A && git commit -m 'hkb init: local store' && git push origin main
  # .kanban/board.json is a TRACKED file (per README's 'Sharing a board'),
  # so it has to be committed for a second clone to see the store key

node bin/hkb.js create "Write a hello file" --body "..." --goal "hello.txt exists and contains hello"
  -> #1 ready (claude) null
node bin/hkb.js claim 1
  -> #1 claimed (attempt 1)          # (the A7 cosmetic fix confirmed: no longer 'attempt 1, attempt 1')
# wrote hello.txt by hand (no harness spawn — see note below)
KB_TASK=1 KB_ATTEMPT=1 node bin/hkb.js heartbeat 1
  -> #1 attempt 1: lease held -> mtlakbp
KB_TASK=1 KB_ATTEMPT=1 node bin/hkb.js finish 1 --from-stdin < finish.json   # {summary, metadata, no_pr: "scratch repo has no forge"}
  -> #1 -> done
node bin/hkb.js sync
  -> sync: pushed 1d3fcba to origin/kb-board

# second clone
git clone origin-bare clone2 && git -C clone2 checkout -b main origin/main
node bin/hkb.js up --serve --port 8322          # (from clone2)
curl localhost:8322/api/board                    # shows the board, dispatcher.running: true
node bin/hkb.js comment 1 "hi"                    # from clone2
  -> exit 2: "the board here is a read-only copy: origin/kb-board exists but
     refs/heads/kb-board does not ... hkb init --take-over"
node bin/hkb.js list --all                        # from clone2, reads fine: #1 done
node bin/hkb.js down --serve                      # both hosts
```
Used a manual `claim` + `finish` rather than `hkb claim --spawn --agent claude-p`: spawning a nested `claude -p` from inside this background worker session risked recursion/cost with no supervision, and the card explicitly allows the manual fallback ('or a manual claim + hkb finish if no harness is available'). The dispatcher process on the non-owning clone ticked correctly (claimed 0) and refused to sync ('nothing to compare-and-swap against'), and any mutating verb there exits 2 naming `hkb init --take-over` — confirms the one-writer rule end to end, not just at the CLI-invocation gate.

**3. Docs and wiki.** New `docs/wiki/concepts/store.md` — a concept-level distillation (one interface, why the local driver has two tiers, the three invariants, one writer, what is deliberately not the store) sitting above the existing deep-mechanics pages `architecture/store-seam.md` and `architecture/local-store.md`, which already covered the write path / one-writer rule / index rebuild in full depth and were left as the detail layer. Added to the wiki's page plan (`wiki.config.yml`). `architecture/overview.md` refreshed: summary and opening paragraph changed from 'the board is the only durable state' / GitHub-only framing to 'the store is the only durable state' with local named as the default and GitHub as the still-live other driver; `concepts/store` added to `related`. Both pages stamped and fresh — `node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` shows 0 stale among the pages this track touched (21 stale remain, all pre-existing drift from before this track, matching #294's own note of '21 stale, all pre-existing'). `CHANGELOG.md` created (none existed) with an Unreleased entry for the local-first store.
